name: agent-discord-wrapper
description: Pairs the external Discord MCP server with a skill so Claude can operate a Discord server - posting text and image attachments, managing channels, roles, threads and moderation - through structured MCP operations instead of hand-driving the Discord API.

bot_token.title: Discord bot token
bot_token.description: The bot token from https://discord.com/developers/applications -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token. Both privileged gateway intents (Server Members, Message Content) must be enabled on that page or every call fails with close code 4014.

guild_id.title: Discord server (guild) ID
guild_id.description: The numeric ID of the one Discord server this plugin operates on. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the server icon -> Copy Server ID. The server handles exactly one guild.
